description: SHA-256 of local source files at training-release extraction; no original files modified.

downstream_evaluation.scope: Small internal-validation examples. Shared reconstruction masks and visible-neighbor mean; coarse-label stratified sampling, unmasked embeddings, L2 normalization, cosine KNN with uniform voting, accuracy and weighted F1.
downstream_evaluation.external_protocol_difference: Full external results additionally use training-reference expression alignment and panel-matched annotation references. The saved external neighbor-mean baseline uses 80% neighbor masking while SOBER uses 20-80%. These internal examples use shared masks and do not implement the full external evaluation.
downstream_evaluation.marker_policy: Literal reconstruction exclusions are applied after alias resolution, matching the saved research analysis; no new canonicalization of exclusion names is introduced.
downstream_evaluation.tutorial_reference: The annotation tutorial uses a class-balanced reference: 64 centers per coarse class from three recorded training regions. This demonstration sampling differs from the manuscript full-atlas reference; query stratification and KNN/metric definitions are unchanged.

radius.scope: 32 coarse T-cell centers in one complete internal-validation UPMC-HNC region; 128 additional sampled candidates; two non-overlapping recipient-donor pairs per center; epoch-10 student.
radius.protocol: Force all non-primer/non-DAPI center markers into a fixed mask; CD3e primer; leave neighbors visible. Match within study/panel; rank-based expression replacement outside nested boundaries preserves recipient geometry. Fisher-average across donor-slot correlations computed over centers.
radius.coordinate_units: µm for tutorial distances, plots and exports; two stored model coordinate units per µm, matching the original analysis and manuscript. Model input coordinates are unchanged.
radius.differences_from_full_analysis: Reduced candidate pool and donor count; single-region fallback; seven distance boundaries and two readouts. No full-cohort spatial decay fit.

parity.compatibility: AST-loaded original functions without module side effects; np.trapz maps to np.trapezoid in the original summary for NumPy 2.x.

clinical.scope: Small examples using cached token-mean embeddings and saved post-transplant state assignments. No raw Wang/Meyer neighborhoods or counterfactual clinical outcomes are included.
clinical.head_origin: Reconstructed from the saved full patient-abundance table using the research classifier and split definitions; not an original serialized head. Predictions checked against saved logits.
clinical.manuscript_scope: State assignment and Fig. S4D patient-score recalculation from cached states. Does not implement Fig. 5G center-cell insertion/protein reconstruction or rerun the encoder. Three patients, one repeat; manuscript S4D reports 53 patients averaged over five repeats.
